title: Document code with ## comments
objective: Tell readers what a function or structure is for, using documentation comments.

body.text: A line that starts with two hash signs, ##, is a documentation comment. A single # comment explains one line. A ## comment describes the thing right below it, such as a function or a structure, so a reader knows what it is for before reading the code.

body.title: Document a function
body.code:
## Greets one person.
function greet
    takes text called name
    say "Hello, {name}!"

greet "Ada"

body.text: A structure can be documented the same way. Write the description just above the word structure.

body.title: Document a structure
body.code:
## A question used by the quiz.
structure question
    has prompt of type text
    has answer of type text

make q equal to a question with prompt "capital of Sweden" and answer "Stockholm"
say prompt of q

body.prompt: Add a documentation comment above the function. It should say: Adds two whole numbers. The program should still print 5.
body.starter:
function add
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left plus right

say add 2 and 3
body.solution:
## Adds two whole numbers.
function add
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left plus right

say add 2 and 3

checks.description: A ## line above the function says Adds two whole numbers.
